title: nan
authors: Zahran S.; Masiero A.; Mostafa M.M.; Moussa A.M.; Vettore A.; El-Sheimy N.
key_contribution: Proposes an enhanced UAV navigation system integrating monocular camera, UWB, and INS with EKF weighting for GNSS-denied operation, validated in an experimental flight.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
